60-canary-band-wire.title: THE ARM REHEARSES AGAINST EVIDENCE: THE SWEEP-DERIVED CERTIFICATION BAND FLOWS INTO RUN_CANARY (Sep 30, canary-band-wire)
60-canary-band-wire.detail: One gated commit carrying the guard-factor validation's last wire (ops/canary_enable.py). The arm rehearsal (run_canary arm=True) rehearses the arm THROUGH evaluate()'s thresholds, and evaluate() refuses to certify the net threshold from a self-derived CI — a missing prior band reads band_certified False and the verdict INCONCLUSIVE (the stale-certification hole closed in task 55). So the gate now derives the band from the sweep evidence it already holds: the CHOSEN CELL's own bootstrap band (ci_p5/ci_p95) of the deltas its replay applied — the distribution the replay actually produced — carried into run_canary(params=...) as the external prior band, scaled to the rehearsal's cycle count by evaluate() itself (the band is per-cycle; the threshold multiplies by n_applied). The rehearsal then grades the arm against evidence, not against nothing: production arms a CERTIFIED band or the arm is not performed at all. prior_band_for_cell(cell): a cell with no applied deltas certifies nothing ((0,0) is the honest empty band — band_certified stays False, INCONCLUSIVE by design). Dry run verified against the live sweep evidence (would arm with the most conservative safe cell). Pins: test_canary 42/0 (task 55's 31 + the band-wire pins — prior_band_for_cell's evidence derivation, the empty-cell honesty, the flow into run_canary).
